A_text_only.name: A — text only
A_text_only.adds: claim parsed into a structured record
A_text_only.note: No evidence is consulted, so nothing can be assessed physically.

B_plus_geography.name: B — + geographic context
B_plus_geography.note: A location is now known, but no observation has been retrieved.

C_plus_earth_observation.name: C — + Earth observation
C_plus_earth_observation.note: Evidence exists, but nothing has been compared over time yet.

D_plus_temporal.name: D — + temporal analysis
D_plus_temporal.adds: change measured across the claim window
D_plus_temporal.note: A verdict is issued from the point estimate alone. Nothing here can decline to answer — which is the gap E closes.

E_plus_uncertainty.name: E — + uncertainty
E_plus_uncertainty.note: The headline of this ablation: without the interval, every one of these would have been answered from the point estimate.

F_full_system.name: F — full system
F_full_system.adds: methane, cross-scale, sufficiency, conflict, evidence ceiling
F_full_system.note: Disagreement between sources is surfaced rather than averaged away. No configuration here reports accuracy.

integrity.why: No adjudicated corpus of true/false flaring claims exists. This ablation measures system behaviour — evidence availability, uncertainty width, abstention, cross-source agreement — and deliberately reports no accuracy metric.
integrity.probe_claims: Claims are constructed from real observed windows to exercise the pipeline uniformly. They are probes, not corporate claims. All observations are real.
